content.json:
# Ankana operations
SLOs: chart generate p95 < 800 ms, reads p95 < 200 ms, errors < 0.5%. Data: Application Insights (workspace-based). Metric names come from `services/api-py/src/app/metrics.py`.

content.title: SLO check
content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name !has '/health' and Name !has '/ready'
| extend kind = case(Name startswith 'POST /v1/clients/{client_id}/charts', 'chart generate',
                     Name startswith 'GET /v1/charts', 'chart read', Name has '/ask', 'ask',
                     Name startswith 'GET', 'other read', 'other write')
| summarize requests = count(), p50 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 50)),
            p95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)),
            errors = countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500) by kind
| extend errorPct = round(100.0 * errors / requests, 2),
         slo = case(kind == 'chart generate', iff(p95 < 800, 'ok', 'BREACH'),
                    kind == 'chart read', iff(p95 < 200, 'ok', 'BREACH'), '')
| order by requests desc

content.title: Latency p50 / p95 / p99 (ms)
content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name !has '/health' and Name !has '/ready'
| summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95),
            p99 = percentile(DurationMs, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

content.title: 5xx error rate (%)
content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name !has '/health' and Name !has '/ready'
| summarize total = count(), failed = countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, errorPct = iff(total == 0, 0.0, 100.0 * failed / total)

content.title: Slowest routes (p95 ms)
content.query:
AppRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name !has '/health' and Name !has '/ready'
| summarize n = count(), p95 = round(percentile(DurationMs, 95)) by Name
| where n >= 5 | top 15 by p95 desc

content.title: Queue depth by kind
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.jobs.queue_depth'
| summarize depth = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), kind = tostring(Properties.kind)

content.title: Oldest ready job (seconds)
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.jobs.oldest_queued_age'
| summarize age = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), kind = tostring(Properties.kind)

content.title: Terminally failed jobs (last 24 h)
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.jobs.failed_recent'
| summarize failed = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), kind = tostring(Properties.kind)

content.title: Job run time, mean seconds
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.jobs.duration'
| summarize seconds = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), kind = tostring(Properties.kind)

content.title: Report render time (mean and max, seconds)
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.report.render.duration'
| summarize mean = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), max = max(Max) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)

content.title: Tokens by provider and type
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.ai.tokens'
| summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h),
  series = strcat(tostring(Properties.provider), ' ', tostring(Properties.type))

content.title: Estimated cost by provider (USD)
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.ai.cost_usd'
| summarize usd = round(sum(Sum), 4)
  by provider = tostring(Properties.provider), model = tostring(Properties.model)
| order by usd desc

content.title: Notification failures
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.notifications.failures'
| summarize failures = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), channel = tostring(Properties.channel)

content.title: Sign-in failures and blocks (brute-force watch)
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.auth.events'
| summarize events = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), action = tostring(Properties.action)

content.title: Rate limiter: limited requests by scope
content.query:
AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == 'ankana.ratelimit.decisions'
| where tostring(Properties.result) == 'limited'
| summarize limited = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), scope = tostring(Properties.scope)
